whatIsSection.title: What Is Company Registration in Dubai?
paragraphs: Registering your company in Dubai means legally registering a business in the UAE mainland, free zone, or offshore jurisdictions.

At Setup Zone Dubai, we assist in the full legal, administrative, and compliance processes of company registration — delivering your trade license, visa, and business bank account setup as quickly as possible.

Dubai offers everything your business needs to grow in a hyper-competitive world, with zero personal and corporate tax, world-class infrastructure, and easy registration. Positioned at the intersection of Europe, Asia, and Africa — the best location for logistics, trade, e-commerce, and consultancy services.

items.q: What is the estimated cost to register a company in Dubai?
items.a: Costs vary based on business activity, jurisdiction (Free Zone or Mainland), number of visas, and office space. Free Zone registration starts from AED 5,750. We offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees.

items.q: Do I need a local sponsor to set up a company in Dubai?
items.a: No. Recent UAE reforms allow 100% foreign ownership in most Free Zones and many Mainland activities. Only specific strategic activities may still require a local partner.

items.q: What is the difference between Free Zone and Mainland company setup?
items.a: Free Zone companies operate within the zone and internationally with 100% foreign ownership. Mainland companies can trade directly in the UAE market, bid for government contracts, and operate across all 7 Emirates.

items.q: Am I able to register a company in Dubai if I am not physically present?
items.a: Yes. Most of the process can be completed remotely. Only medical tests and Emirates ID biometrics require physical presence — we coordinate everything for a quick visit.

items.q: How many visas can I apply for under my company license?
items.a: Visa quota depends on your license type and office space. Free Zones typically allow 1-6 visas per license. Mainland allows unlimited visas based on office size.

items.q: What are the best business activities to register in Dubai that can be very profitable?
items.a: Popular profitable activities include General Trading, E-commerce, Digital Marketing, IT Services, Consulting, Logistics, FinTech, Web3/AI/SaaS, Healthcare, and Education.

items.q: Can my company issue me a residence visa for the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Your company can sponsor your investor or employment visa, and then sponsor your family members as dependents. We handle the entire visa process.

Dubai offers 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and no currency restrictions. Corporate tax applies at current thresholds with qualifying small businesses potentially benefiting from 0% tax.

items.q: Can I open a corporate bank account in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. We assist with opening corporate bank accounts at Emirates NBD, Mashreq, ADCB, RAKBANK, and international banks. Full support with KYC, documents, and activation.

items.q: How long does it take to get my business license in Dubai?
items.a: Free Zone licenses typically in 2-5 working days. Mainland licenses take 5-7 days for license, with complete setup (including visas and office) taking 2-4 weeks.
